title: M&A, investing & affiliates, a conversation with Fintan Costello
description: Meet Fintan Costello whom runs The Gambling Files podcast and has had a successful career in iGaming leading up to an exit to the Gambling.com group. I took a page out of his podcast playbook and setup this episode without any agenda or planned questions and just talked. We covered a wide range of topics from affiliate marketing, data in the iGaming industry, investing, exits, M&A strategies and even how to create a good company culture.
